dang.y: đi làm mà đầu vẫn ở tập tối qua
dang.title: still thinking about it
dang.prompt: a takeaway coffee cup on a bus seat beside a window with rain streaks, city blur outside, early morning grey light, no face visible, natural phone photo
dang.description: on the bus replaying one scene from last night in my head. the way she just walked out without saying a word. i have a meeting in twenty minutes and this is all i can think about

chu_de: Đời thường · nấu mì lúc nửa đêm

dang.y: đói lúc nửa đêm vì xem phim
dang.title: midnight noodles
dang.prompt: a bowl of instant noodles steaming on a small kitchen counter at night, only the stove light on, chopsticks resting on the rim, cozy, no people, natural phone photo
dang.description: paused at the worst possible moment to make noodles because i realised i had not eaten since lunch. came back and watched three more. the noodles went cold. worth it

chu_de: Đời thường · cuối tuần không ra khỏi nhà

dang.y: thứ bảy ở nhà trùm chăn
dang.title: saturday plans
dang.prompt: a thick knitted blanket on a sofa with a phone and a mug of tea on the armrest, soft daylight from a window, lazy weekend mood, no face visible, natural photo
dang.description: my saturday plans: this blanket, this tea, and finding out if he actually remembers who she is. friends asked if i wanted to go out. i said maybe next week

dang.y: ra ngoài hít thở sau khi cày phim

dang.prompt: a park path covered in fallen autumn leaves, a pair of sneakers at the bottom of the frame, golden afternoon light through trees, no face visible, natural phone photo
dang.description: forced myself outside for a walk after finishing a whole series in one sitting. the leaves are doing their thing. still thinking about that ending though

dang.title: he has opinions
dang.prompt: an orange cat lying across a phone on a bed, looking at the camera, warm lamp light in the evening, cozy bedroom, natural phone photo
dang.description: right at the part where the truth finally comes out, he decides my phone is the warmest spot in the house. i waited eleven minutes. he did not move

dang.title: monday again
dang.prompt: a desk with a laptop, a half finished coffee and a sticky note, grey morning light from an office window, quiet workplace, no people, natural phone photo
dang.description: slept maybe five hours because i needed to know if she would forgive him. she did not. good for her honestly. now please let this coffee work

dang.y: hỏi bạn bè nên xem gì tiếp

dang.description: finished everything on my list. i need something new for tonight. revenge plots, secret identities, a slow burn, i am not picky. what are you watching right now
